notes: K1: Lampatronics' 'within an hour' assembly answer is counted under K1 (the guide's K1 example), not also under K4. Electrician-1's 40/head, eight-today offer was kept only as a backup and never used, so it is left out of K1 (it is counted in K3). K2: each item named in an ask is counted separately, even when several were alternatives for the same need (tall stand, mic stand, clamp arm, book stand). Merging alternatives per shop would give about 27 opportunities with 23 happened. Abdelrahman's repeat ask at mobile-accessories-1 (log 131) is the same item at the same shop and is not counted again. Asks to borrow a USB test source at Harby and Lampatronics are counted as item asks. The Carrefour low cradle is counted as its own ask because Seb funded eight and Mostafa went back to inspect them. K3: electronics_retail-1 and -2 are 'unclear' because the log says they have no joining service, but the workers' reports never show them being asked to do the work. K5: none of the 25 technician-made heads was ever powered (no socket or USB source was found on either day), so there are no opportunities. K6: actual time is measured from pickup to arrival where the log gives the pickup time (the Sunday quotes exclude waiting). For the first two Thursday rides no pickup time is logged, so it is measured from booking. The last ride (Carrefour to Hadayek October) ends after the record does, so it is 'unclear'.
